facts.text: Training shall be completed before each fire season and refreshed whenever operating procedures or field configurations change
The training program shall be role based

Tabletop exercises shall be conducted before the expected peak fire period
Live exercises shall be scheduled at least once per season when conditions permit

Performance measures shall include time from automated detection to human review, time from review to command notification, time to resource assignment, communication completion rate, and accuracy of incident status updates
